metadata_mirror.note: Used as a working mirror after the official archive quota response. Byte-for-byte identity with the official Google Drive archive has not been independently verified.

selection.stratification: ground-truth reason set; exactly 2 scored incidents per each of 5 strata
selection.development_overlap_policy: exclude any development [alert_start - 30m, alert_end) interval that overlaps a scored interval; half-open endpoint adjacency is allowed

alert_kpi.status: No fixed KPI is supplied by the OpenRCA Telecom query text. The alert contains only the supplied 30-minute failure window; KPI selection is deferred to telemetry-backed development analysis.
alert_kpi.alert_construction: normalized from the supplied query instruction time window; scoring_points omitted
